title: The Slow-Crab Walk with the Wide Tray
youtube_title: The Slow-Crab Walk with the Wide Tray | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: A big job feels lighter when two people each take a side.
summary: Asha cannot hold the wide tray alone, so she and Uncle walk it like a slow crab, share the quilt corners, and trade telescope jobs without losing the moon.
